title: unifold unit manifest
description: unit.yaml, or the YAML front matter of a unit's README.md. See manifest.md and wiring.md.

unit.description: Name of the unit. Equals the folder name, except for the root unit.

summary.description: What the unit is, in one line.

unifold.description: Version of the standard. Root manifest only.

ignore.description: Folders, relative to the root, that are not scanned. Root manifest only.

diagram-links.description: none, relative, or the base URL of the repository's file view. Root manifest only.

kind.description: What sort of thing the unit is. Free vocabulary.

owner.description: Team or person responsible. Inherited by units below.

provides.description: Provided ports, keyed by port name.

wiring.description: Need (key) to provider (value). A map of named providers means alternatives; the first is the default.

needEndpoint.description: An own provided port (bare name) or a need of a direct child (child.need).

providerEndpoint.description: An own need (bare name), a port of a direct child (child.port), or a plain folder (./path).

contract.description: Path inside the unit, or a URL.

verified-by.description: Tests or checks that hold the unit to the contract: path inside the unit, or a URL.

conforms-to.description: Name of a need of the same unit whose definition this port implements.

contract.description: The interface the unit expects, defined by the unit: path inside the unit, or a URL.
